cost: O(B log K + E log E) load approximation; match O(V K H F (S + (A+P) H R + P Q)) with repeated ancestor scans, plus BTreeSet chain O(H log H). B bytes, K classes, E frequency rows, H depth, F frames per ancestor, S syntax tokens, A objects, P clause PPs, Q frame PPs, R roles. No speed claim.
description: Let T=(verbnet,nominals,frequencies) be supplied UTF-8 tables and C a finite clause. Load T in order, index classes, expand ancestor frames, score candidates, select stable class optionally, choose first maximum, then require every core slot assigned. Result is None or (class,frame-source,frame-index,score,verb,role vectors). Globals additionally read stable policy and recording flag; recording invokes the unchanged unique-winner update via a callback.

inverse: B(y)={(T,C):F(T,C)=y} on the supplied domain. Filler values, unchosen classes and irrelevant nominal rows may vary; None includes missing verbs, expletive frames and core mismatch. Preserve shared class indices when composing child preimages.
limitations: Bounded supplied tables and clauses only; global recording lifecycle unexecuted.
